Apple’s newest iPad is the most boring iPad yet, and a major missed opportunity (AAPL) 
Apple unveiled a new iPad last week. The new iPad is not very different from the 9.7-inch iPad unveiled last March. Apple could have done more to get people excited about the iPad, and missed some opportunities to sweeten the deal for the educational market, too.
